items.title: 任天堂确认将继续推出实体游戏
items.summary: 任天堂拉丁美洲副总裁兼总经理比尔·范·齐尔表示，任天堂目前没有放弃实体游戏版的计划，不会跟随全面转向数字版的脚步。他强调，任天堂深知玩家对实体游戏的热爱，将充分考虑消费者需求并根据玩家偏好调整策略，立场保持开放。 此前，PlayStation 宣布即将全面放弃实体版，引发了外界对行业走向的广泛讨论。相较之下，任天堂去年推出的 Nintendo Switch 2 同时具备数字与实体功能，实体版形式分为完整卡带和游戏兑换卡两种。

ja.title: 任天堂は物理的なゲームのリリースを継続することを確認
ja.summary: 任天堂ラテンアメリカ担当副社長兼ゼネラルマネージャーのビル・ヴァン・ジル氏は、任天堂は現時点でゲームのパッケージ版を放棄する計画はなく、デジタル版への完全な移行の足跡をたどることはないと述べた。同氏は、任天堂はプレイヤーの物理的なゲームへの愛情をよく認識しており、消費者のニーズを十分に考慮し、プレイヤーの好みに基づいて戦略を調整し、オープンマインドであり続けると強調した。以前、PlayStation はすべてのパッケージ版を放棄すると発表し、業界の方向性について広範な議論を引き起こしました。それに比べて、任天堂が昨年発売した「Nintendo Switch 2」は、デジタル機能と物理的機能の両方を備えている。物理版は、コンプリート カートリッジとゲーム引き換えカードの 2 種類に分かれています。

en.title: Nintendo confirms it will continue to release physical games
en.summary: Bill Van Zyl, vice president and general manager of Nintendo Latin America, said that Nintendo currently has no plans to abandon the physical version of the game and will not follow the footsteps of a full switch to digital versions. He emphasized that Nintendo is well aware of players' love for physical games, will fully consider consumer needs and adjust strategies based on player preferences, and remains open-minded. Previously, PlayStation announced that it would give up all physical versions, triggering extensive discussions about the direction of the industry. In comparison, the Nintendo Switch 2 launched by Nintendo last year has both digital and physical functions. The physical version is divided into two types: complete cartridges and game redemption cards.

Tencent said that due to changes in its business development strategy, it regretfully made this decision after friendly consultations with Ubisoft. The specific arrangements for the outage are as follows: At 11 o'clock on October 12, 2026, game recharge and new user registration will be stopped; At 11 o'clock on December 14, 2026, game operations will be officially stopped, the game server will be closed, the official game website will be closed, and users will not be able to log in to the game; At 11 o'clock on December 22, 2026, the forum and dedicated customer service will be closed. It is reported that users who have recharged "The Division 2" before 11 o'clock on October 12, 2026 and have tokens retained in their accounts can enter the compensation page during the compensation event to receive related gift packages for the "Peace Elite" mobile game, "Spade Battle" mobile game, "Fearless Contract" mobile game, "CrossFire" mobile game and "Honor of Kings" mobile game according to their account balance.

This is the second time that the Chinese team won the gold medal in the "Honor of Kings" event after the Hangzhou Asian Games. Player Yinuo (Xu Bicheng) became the first and only double gold medal winner in the league in history. items.title: チョコレートの香りを嗅ぐだけで筋トレのパフォーマンスが向上する可能性
items.summary: 香りは食欲や感情、行動など、人の心身にさまざまな影響を与えることが知られています。チョコレートの香りを嗅ぐだけで、筋力トレーニングでこなせる運動量が増える可能性があることが、マラヤ大学の研究で新たに示されました。続きを読む...

zh.title: 仅仅闻巧克力的味道就可以提高肌肉训练的表现
zh.summary: 众所周知，气味对人们的思想和身体有多种影响，包括食欲、情绪和行为。马来亚大学的一项新研究发现，仅仅闻巧克力的味道就可以增加力量训练期间的运动量。阅读更多...

en.title: Just smelling chocolate may improve muscle training performance
en.summary: Scents are known to have a variety of effects on people's minds and bodies, including appetite, emotions, and behavior. A new study from the University of Malaya has found that simply smelling chocolate can increase the amount of exercise you can do during strength training. read more...

items.title: 「言語モデルはテキストを理解していない」ことを意味する「確率的オウム」とは？
items.summary: AIはもっともらしい文章を生成できるものの、処理対象の言語の意味を理解しているわけではないということを例えた「確率的オウム」という言葉があります。そんな確率的オウムという比喩を提唱した論文の共著者が、詳しい理論とよくある誤解について解説しています。続きを読む...

zh.title: 什么是“概率鹦鹉”，意思是“语言模型不理解文本”？
zh.summary: 有一个术语叫做“概率鹦鹉”，指的是这样一个事实：虽然人工智能可以生成看似合理的句子，但它不一定理解它正在处理的语言的含义。提出概率鹦鹉隐喻的论文的合著者解释了详细的理论和常见的误解。阅读更多...

en.title: What is "probabilistic parrot" which means "the language model does not understand the text"?
en.summary: There is a term called ``probabilistic parrot'' that refers to the fact that although AI can generate plausible sentences, it does not necessarily understand the meaning of the language it is processing. The co-author of the paper that proposed the probabilistic parrot metaphor explains the detailed theory and common misconceptions. read more...
